meaning: Registers the run id :m3vpasd as model M3 with a VP shunt plus anti-siphon device, with a legend label and the shared purple colour #7B1FA2. It is a registry/value decision: it selects model, shunt variant and appearance for that run id, not the physics equations.

could_move.what: Legend text and curve colour for this run. All six ASD rows share #7B1FA2, so ASD variants are indistinguishable in any deck drawing more than one of them.
Which shunt variant is attached when the deck solves (:vp_asd), so the curves themselves move if this symbol is wrong.
Any deck built through the registry consumer path picks up this row as written.
Batch deck runs that enumerate run ids.

expectation: Unknown in size. If only label and colour are at stake, the effect is cosmetic but can make two ASD curves unreadable in one panel; if the :vp_asd tag or the model tag is wrong, the plotted physics changes. I cannot tell from this context which decks actually reference :m3vpasd.

check.why: Lists every deck, script and report that uses this run id, and shows how many rows share the same colour, before spending a solve or a re-fit.
